project: Project Rahul — Family 2D Pixel-Art Fighting Game

animations.gameplay_purpose: Match-winning celebration reflecting Rahul's gym-enthusiast confidence and muscular strength without becoming a stage bodybuilding routine.
animations.starting_pose_description: F1: Combat completion settling into upright standing stance.
animations.ending_pose_description: F6: Commanding, relaxed standing victory hold pose with squared shoulders, clenched fists at sides, and a confident slight smile.
animations.cross_batch_transition_notes: Enters smoothly from any completed attack or Batch 1/4 standing stance; F6 holds indefinitely on the victory screen.

animations.gameplay_purpose: Standing match-loss reaction (e.g. time-over defeat) communicating genuine physical exhaustion and disappointment without collapsing.
animations.starting_pose_description: F1: Fighting guard dropping as Rahul registers the match loss.
animations.ending_pose_description: F5: Stable exhausted standing defeat hold with slumped shoulders, bowed head, and hand braced near lead thigh/knee.
animations.cross_batch_transition_notes: Enters from Batch 1 Standing Guard; visually distinct from Batch 3 Heavy Hit Reaction and Batch 5 KO; F5 holds cleanly on the defeat screen.

pivot_and_ground_anchor.notes: F1–F3 standing impact & backward buckle on Y=272; F4 back-first fall inches above floor; F5 ground slam impact; F6 motionless supine KO pose (240x73 px, head LEFT, feet RIGHT).

animations.gameplay_purpose: Permanent match-ending knockout collapse triggered when Rahul's health reaches zero.
animations.starting_pose_description: F1: Final knockout impact jolt snapping head and chest back to the left.
animations.ending_pose_description: F6: Motionless supine unconscious KO state lying flat on Y=272 (240 px wide, head LEFT, feet RIGHT), holdable indefinitely.
animations.cross_batch_transition_notes: F6 matches Batch 3 rahul_27_knockdown_fall_6f.png F6 in exact 240 px horizontal footprint, supine head-left/feet-right orientation, scale, and Y=272 ground baseline.

animations.gameplay_purpose: Personality-defining in-match taunt expressing Rahul's gym-enthusiast pride via a controlled biceps flex and playful 'bring it on' beckoning challenge.
animations.starting_pose_description: F1: Standard standing fighting guard matching Batch 1 Idle F1.
animations.ending_pose_description: F6: Smooth return to exact Batch 1 standing fighting guard (228 px height).
animations.cross_batch_transition_notes: Seamless entry from and recovery back to Batch 1 rahul_01_idle_8f.png F1 (228 px standing height across all 6 frames).
